question: Which of our existing strategy books, at which risk scale, has the best chance of passing the evaluations of prominent crypto-capable prop firms, and which firm/book/scale has the best expected value per challenge fee?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-02 before any simulation. Rules are a snapshot taken 2026-10-02 from the firms' own pages where available (ftmo.com/en/trading-objectives, hyrotrader.com) and from kraken.com/learn/breakout-vs-hyrotrader for Breakout (Kraken owns Breakout); items marked 'assumed' were not on those pages and must be verified before buying a challenge. Return series are the historical daily net books already computed in this repository (all seen data), so results are descriptive; the development/confirmation split guards the choice of book and scale.

FTMO_2step.notes: daily loss on equity, 00:00 CET reset; split and fee (EUR 540 / 100k) assumed from prior FTMO pricing

FTMO_1step.notes: trailing max loss recalculated daily; split and fee assumed

HyroTrader_1step.notes: USD 579 / 100k from hyrotrader.com; Bybit perps, 700+ pairs

Breakout_classic_1step.notes: 62 pairs on Kraken; leverage 5:1 BTC/ETH, 2:1 alts; fee assumed 0.5% of account

simulation.returns: daily net returns of each book (20 bps costs, funding proxy) times a risk scale L
simulation.intraday_buffer: daily equity is only observed at day ends, so a day counts as breaching the daily loss if its return is below -0.8 x the limit (20% buffer for intraday excursions); the max-loss checks use the same 0.8 buffer
simulation.starts: a challenge starts on every 7th day of the series (overlapping), phases run back to back, each phase capped at 120 days (unfinished = fail)
simulation.best_day_rule: when the target is hit, the best single day must be <= 50% of the sum of positive days in that phase, otherwise the phase continues
simulation.min_days: calendar days in the phase >= min_days (our books hold positions every day)
simulation.funded: after passing, simulate 180 funded days with the same daily/max-loss rules; payout = split x max(0, profit at day 180 or at breach-free cash-outs every 30 days)
simulation.ev: expected value per 100 USD of account = P(pass) x E[funded payout] - fee; reported per firm, book and scale

books.S4_blend: multi-premia equal-risk blend (trend + XS momentum + funding carry)
books.H10_human: multi-premia blend held as the 10 largest coins at a daily 08:00 UTC check-in

selection_rule: the best (book, scale) per firm is chosen on the development sample by EV per fee; it is reported on the confirmation sample unchanged; a firm/book/scale is 'recommended' only if its confirmation pass rate is >= 0.6 x its development pass rate and its confirmation EV is positive
